thread:
jordan: Heads up — final rollforward window starts in ~2h. Code freeze at 22:00 UTC tonight. Only security fixes, infra hotpatches, or approved late-merge exceptions after release lead sign-off.

maya: noted. is the cutoff enforced by CI? any auto-blocks?

release-bot: deploy-checks: branch-protection enabled, required checks: `release/smoke`, `ci/e2e`. Merges with failing required checks will be blocked automatically.

samir: I have a tiny compat bump (pkg version bump + lockfile). Should I open a normal PR or file an exception?

jordan: If it's strictly a version bump with no runtime change, open a normal PR and add `changelog:skip` in the body, then ping me. If it touches deps that affect runtime or starts any migration path, open a late-merge exception and add the `release/late-merge` label.

lina: @samir I can do a quick review in 30m if you want — helps speed approval. Also include a brief safety blurb in the PR: why it's safe for last minute.

samir: thanks @lina — will push in ~15m.

maya: quick question — for cherry-picks into `release/v1.12.x` do we prefer `git cherry-pick -x` or do we create a new commit?

jordan: Use `git cherry-pick -x <commit>` so the original commit is referenced. Push to a branch like `cherry/samir/compat-bump` and open a PR targeting `release/v1.12.x`. Add `release/late-merge` + `needs-approval:release`.

lina: also paste CI job links or a small test matrix screenshot in the PR to avoid extra back-and-forth.

ops-bot: heads-up: infra blackout between 21:30-22:30 UTC tonight for regional maintenance. Avoid infra-only changes during that window.

samir: branch pushed and PR opened: https://git.company/repo/pull/4827 — added `release/late-merge` label and short safety note.

jordan: I will review in ~10. If approved, @ops-team please monitor the 30m rollback window after deploy. :eyes:

maya: docs note — if there is any user-visible change we need a changelog entry. If you use `changelog:skip`, ping docs to confirm.

samir: no user-visible changes here, so `changelog:skip` applied.

jordan: Decision: PR approved by me at ~10m after opening. Merge will occur after CI passes. Reminder: do NOT force-merge failing checks. Ping me for flakes.

release-bot: merge queued — will auto-merge when `ci/e2e` and `release/smoke` complete successfully.

lina: thanks everyone, nice and smooth. :thumbsup:

samir: merged at ~20m after PR opened — post-merge smoke passed. tagging for release notes.

jordan: Great — exception closed. Will note the cherry-pick in the release notes under "cherry-picks & last-minute fixes."
